triples.tail_surface: Press the seat into place with the fingers and check that all parts are correctly imbedded
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用手指将阀座压入到位并检查所有零件是否正确嵌入
triples.evidence_text:
3. Press the seat into place with the fingers and
check that all parts are correctly imbedded.

triples.tail_surface: protect the sliding surface of the seat to prevent it from being scratched or cut
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 保护密封座滑动面以防止其被划伤或切割
triples.evidence_text:
NOTE: If it is necessary to use tools for assembling, then protect the sliding surface of the
seat to prevent it from being scratched or cut.

triples.tail_surface: Lubricate the inner surface of the slide ring rubber bellows with a thin layer of silicone grease
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用薄层硅脂润滑滑环橡胶波纹管内表面
triples.evidence_text:
Lubricate the inner surface of the slide ring
rubber bellows with a thin layer of silicone grease (ensure that no silicone grease ends up at
the slide surfaces) and push it over the shaft.

triples.tail_surface: The use of a conical fitting bush as shown on the assembly drawing is recommended to avoid that the rubber bellows is cut
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 建议使用装配图所示的锥形安装衬套以避免橡胶波纹管被割伤
triples.evidence_text:
The use of a conical fitting bush as shown on
the assembly drawing is recommended to avoid that the rubber bellows is cut.

triples.tail_surface: Push the slide ring over the shaft with the hand
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: Push the slide ring over the shaft with the hand.

triples.tail_surface: use a fitting tool and take care that the slide ring is not damaged
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用安装工具并注意不要损坏滑环
triples.evidence_text:
If the rubber bellows is tight, use a
fitting tool and take care that the slide ring is not damaged.

triples.tail_surface: check that it is fitted correctly, i.e. the chamfered/lapped side is to face the seat
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查其安装是否正确，即倒角/研磨面应朝向阀座
triples.evidence_text:
If the carbon ring is not fixed, it is
important to check that it is fitted correctly, i.e. the chamfered/lapped side is to face the seat.

triples.tail_surface: check by viewing the leak hole that there are no leaks
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过观察泄漏孔检查是否有泄漏
triples.evidence_text:
After start, check by viewing the
leak hole that there are no leaks.

triples.tail_surface: Fit the sunk key in the shaft and lead the impeller towards the shoulder of the shaft. Secure the impeller with washers (7 and 8) and a nut
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将平键装入轴中并将叶轮导向轴肩，用垫圈和螺母固定叶轮
triples.evidence_text:
1. Fit the sunk key in the shaft and lead the
impeller towards the shoulder of the shaft.
Secure the impeller with washers (7 and 8) and
a nut.
